basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 22.' and it opens 'Vers. 22. Sella genuit Tubalcain. Sed et de hoc idem Josephus dicit: « Tubalcain res'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 22. Sella genuit Tubalcain. Sed et de hoc idem Josephus dicit: « Tubalcain res bellicas decenter exercuit, artem ferrariam docuit: quaedam etiam, quae ad libidinem oculorum pertinent, adinvenit. » Soror Tubalcain Noema. Notandum quod in generatione Seth nulla mulier nata legitur: in Cain vero generatione legitur soror Tubalcain progenita, per quod designatur lascivia et petulantia quae reprobis in praesenti dominatur vita.
